item.title: ZVM: a based EVM rollup to mainnet, an embedded verifier later
item.body:
Smart contracts for NoM without a VM on L1: momentums order the transactions, a deriver
makes one EVM block per momentum, and withdrawals are released first by a FROST committee
and later against a validity proof (roadmap M5a and M5b).

- No fork: fix the relayer livelock and show the faucet's limit
- Plan and open the mainnet inbox at mainnet's caps, 100 blocks per momentum and no fee market
- Spork: an embedded rollup verifier that retires the committee
item.author: dev-ada
